note: Bank of Bhutan's Visa Domestic and Visa International Credit Card pages (fees and charges revised inclusive of GST, read 2026-10-30) and its Visa Credit Card Application Form (uploaded July 2026), whose schedule of fees and charges and interest example set the terms the pages leave out. Both cards, in ngultrum: 1,048.95 a year; at issue, the new card issuance fee (525) and the joining fee charged once for a holder's first card (525), written as one issue fee of 1,050; interest on the revolving credit facility of 2.5% a month; up to 45 days of interest-free credit; a minimum payment of 10% of the monthly outstanding balance; cash withdrawals bear 1.5% a month from the day of withdrawal, and a fee of 2.10% with a floor of 210 at the bank's own ATMs (written; at other ATMs it is 3.15% with a floor of 315, not written); a late payment fee of 0.525% of the outstanding amount with a floor of 210 (levied over and above the regular interest), and an over-limit fee of 0.525% of the amount over the limit with a floor of 210. The International card adds a 1.58% fee on foreign-currency transactions; the Domestic card, used in Bhutan, India and Nepal, has none. Fees are written as the pages give them, GST included, so no tax is added. Not written: the form's processing fee and credit information report charge (Nu 300 each before GST, which the pages' revised schedule doesn't list), the renewal and replacement fees, the 70%-of-net-pay limit rule and the limit's floors and ceilings. Bhutan National Bank's Gold Visa credit card publishes its fees (Nu 1,499 new card, 599 a year, 1.5% on forex) but no interest rate, so it isn't written.
